name: working-memory
description: Workstream-aware session journal for Michael's hub workspace.

enumDescriptions: Use a running control-plane service if one is reachable, otherwise self-host (spawn + supervise) it.
The extension always spawns and supervises the control-plane process itself.
An external OS service owns the control-plane process; the extension is a pure client and never spawns it.
workingMemory.controlPlane.hosting.markdownDescription: Who runs the control-plane process: **auto** (use a running service if reachable, else self-host), **embedded** (extension spawns + supervises it), or **service** (external OS service; extension is a pure client).

workingMemory.controlPlane.storePath.markdownDescription: Filesystem directory for the control-plane's SQLite files. Empty = per-OS app-data default. Maps to the `WM_CONTROL_PLANE_HOME` environment variable.

workingMemory.controlPlane.port.markdownDescription: TCP port the extension connects to when an EXTERNAL control-plane daemon owns the process — i.e. `#workingMemory.controlPlane.hosting#` = **service**, or **auto** while probing for a running service. Ignored in **embedded** / auto-self-host mode, where the extension spawns the daemon on an ephemeral port and learns the actual bound port automatically. Set this to match the port your external/OS-service daemon binds (`WM_CONTROL_PLANE_PORT`).

workingMemory.nanites.maxConcurrent.markdownDescription: How many `Queued` nanites the dispatcher runs at once. Start at **1**; raise to run more background nanites in parallel (each is a live model call, so higher values cost more).

workingMemory.localModel.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the local Ollama/Llama server that powers the right-rail command widget. The widget POSTs to `${baseUrl}/api/chat` with constrained decoding (a JSON-schema `format` grammar that forces schema-valid tool-call args).

workingMemory.localModel.model.markdownDescription: Model tag the command widget asks the local server to run. Must be a tool-capable model. Default **`qwen3:14b`**; **`qwen2.5:14b`** is a known-good fallback.

workingMemory.localModel.maxIterations.markdownDescription: Maximum tool-calling turns the command widget's agentic loop takes before it gives up (the classic small-model "never stops" guard).

workingMemory.localModel.disableThinking.markdownDescription: Send `think: false` on command-widget chat requests to disable a reasoning model's hidden `<think>` tokens. This is an **Ollama-specific** extension — leave it **on** for the default Ollama endpoint, but turn it **off** if `#workingMemory.localModel.baseUrl#` points at a non-Ollama server that may reject the unknown `think` field.
